title: Multilingual transcription + translate action
description: 1) Enable language_detection in AssemblyAI submit for multilingual/code-switching audio. 2) Add translate action to chat system: new targetLanguage field on MeetingAction, GPT-4o translates segments in batches, rewrites stored segments, regenerates summary.

title: Fix API compatibility for gpt-4o-mini-transcribe model
description: Switch response_format from verbose_json to json, remove timestamp_granularities param, add parser fallback for text-only responses (no segments key). Create synthetic segment from text field when segments absent.

title: Add error logging to transcription chunk pipeline
description: Replace silent try? with do/catch + logging in WhisperTranscriptionService.transcribe(systemURL:micURL:). Log HTTP status, x-request-id, and error body per chunk. Make parseWhisperResponse throw on unexpected JSON. Include collected errors in thrown WhisperError.

title: GPT-4o speaker inference as post-processing pass
description: After hybrid transcription (AssemblyAI diarization + OpenAI text), run GPT-4o speaker inference as a second pass to correct/improve speaker labels using conversational patterns. The inferSpeakers method already exists in WhisperTranscriptionService but is only used in the single-file path. Wire it into the hybrid pipeline in AppState.stopAndProcess, MeetingActionExecutor retranscribe, and AppState.importAudio.

title: Hybrid transcription: AssemblyAI diarization + OpenAI transcription
description:
AssemblyAI handles multilingual audio poorly (merges languages) but does speaker diarization well. gpt-4o-mini-transcribe handles multilingual well but has no speaker detection.

Proposed hybrid pipeline:
1. Send system audio to AssemblyAI with speaker_labels — extract speaker-tagged time ranges (speaker A: 0-5s, speaker B: 5-12s, etc.) but discard the transcript text
2. Send same audio to gpt-4o-mini-transcribe for accurate multilingual transcription
3. Align: map AssemblyAI speaker labels onto OpenAI transcript segments by timestamp overlap

This replaces the current approach where AssemblyAI does both diarization AND transcription.

Affected files:
- AssemblyAITranscriptionService.swift — add method to extract diarization-only (speaker + timestamps, no text)
- WhisperTranscriptionService.swift — already does transcription, may need timestamp improvements
- AppState.swift — orchestrate hybrid pipeline in stopAndProcess
- MeetingActionExecutor.swift — same hybrid logic for retranscribe

Risks:
- Timestamp alignment between two providers may not be exact — need fuzzy matching with tolerance
- Doubles API cost (both providers called for system audio)
- AssemblyAI polling adds latency on top of OpenAI transcription — could run in parallel

title: Import audio file into plain note
description:
Add drag-and-drop + file picker to NoteEditorView so users can attach phone recordings.

Flow: drop/pick audio file -> copy to app storage (ImportedAudio/) -> Whisper transcribe -> GPT speaker inference -> summarize -> attach MeetingAttachment to existing note in-place.

Key: fix WhisperTranscriptionService content-type to detect file extension (m4a/mp3/wav) instead of hardcoding audio/wav. Pause autosave while importing. Keep existing note body/tags/title. Switch to MeetingDetailView on success via selectedNote refresh.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description: Extend meeting chat so AI can take actions: retranscribe audio, regenerate summary, rename speakers, add/remove tags. Also add recovery UX for failed meetings.
close_reason: Implemented: chatWithMeetingControl, MeetingActionExecutor, updated MeetingChatView with recovery UX. Build passes.

title: AssemblyAI speaker diarization for system audio
description:
Replace WhisperTranscriptionService system-audio path with AssemblyAI Universal-3 Pro + Speaker Diarization add-on ($0.23/hr total, cheaper than Whisper alone at $0.36/hr).

System audio (remote participants) gets sent to AssemblyAI for acoustic diarization -> speakers tagged 2..N.
Mic track (local) stays as Whisper Speaker 1.
Merge by timestamp, same as current dual-track path.

New service: Services/AssemblyAIService.swift
New settings fields: assemblyAIApiKey in AppState + SettingsView.
Fallback to Whisper-only if AssemblyAI key missing or call fails.
Codex scoping done: /tmp/codex-diarization.md

title: Fix audio clipping regression
description: writeSampleBuffer in AudioRecorder.swift converts Float32->Int16 without peak normalization (removed when switching from mixing to per-stream writes). Re-add peak normalization: peak = max(abs(samples)), gain = min(0.9/peak, 4.0), clamp to [-1,1] before Int16 conversion. Sonnet fix already applied — needs Codex review + commit.

title: AI chat with full meeting control
description:
Extend MeetingDetailView chat to support AI-triggered actions via structured JSON output.

Actions: retranscribe (re-run Whisper), regenerate_summary (with optional user context), rename_speaker, add_tag, remove_tag.

New OpenAIService method: chatWithMeetingControl() -> ChatOrActionResult (mode: answer|action, assistantMessage, action: {type, args}).
New MeetingActionExecutor service validates and executes mutations.
Recovery UX: when segments.isEmpty && audioFilePath != nil, show chat chips 'Retranscribe this meeting'.
Separate isRunningAction state for long ops. Failure appended as chat message, not silent print.
Capture note ID before async actions to avoid stale overwrites.

title: Export audio file to user-chosen location
description:
Currently recorded audio is stored internally in ~/Library/Application Support/OnlyNotes/Recordings/. Users want to export/save a copy of the audio file to any location they choose (e.g. Desktop, shared drive) so they can share recordings with their team.

Proposed approach:
- Add an 'Export Audio' button in MeetingDetailView (near the existing audio player bar)
- Use NSSavePanel to let user pick destination filename and location
- Copy the audio file from internal storage to the chosen path
- Show success/error feedback

Affected files:
- MeetingDetailView.swift — add export audio button + NSSavePanel logic

Edge cases:
- Meeting has no audio file (imported note, failed recording) — hide/disable button
- File already exists at destination — NSSavePanel handles overwrite confirmation natively
- Large files — use FileManager.copyItem (not Data load) to avoid memory issues

title: Action chaining: compound chat requests
description:
Support compound chat requests like 'retranscribe and translate to English' by allowing the chat system to return multiple sequential actions.

Current limitation: chatWithMeetingControl returns a single MeetingAction per response. Users must send separate messages for multi-step workflows.

Proposed approach:
- Update system prompt to support returning an array of actions in sequence
- Change response parsing to handle both single action and action pipeline
- Update MeetingDetailView executor loop to run actions sequentially, feeding output of each step into the next
- Ensure partial failure handling: if step 2 fails, step 1 results are still saved

Affected files:
- OpenAIService.swift (prompt + response parsing)
- MeetingDetailView.swift (executor loop)
- MeetingActionExecutor.swift (may need pipeline-aware execution)
